# 1. Load libraries and functions
```{R}
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, sf, raster, terra, fasterize, reshape2, effects, gridExtra, geosphere, mapview, gdistance, viridis)
source("code/function script.r")
```

# 2. Load datasets and prepare data for analysis
Align projections, crop to same extent, and filter out non ocean ports
```{R loading data}
e <- extent(148.00916, 149.34895, -21.34380, -19.90391)
pop_raster  		<- rast("data/population_aus_northeast_2018-10-01.tif") %>%
                       crop(e) %>%
                       project("+proj=utm +zone=55 +south +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")#population density grid cells
ecodata_reduced 	<- read.csv("data/ECObarg_sites.csv") %>%
                       dplyr::select(2,9,10) %>%
					   unique()
queensland_roads 	<- st_read("data/queensland_roads.gpkg") %>%
                       st_crop(e) %>%
					   filter(CLASS != "Ferry") %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster)) %>%
					   st_as_sf()
bathy				<- rast("data/3_ausseabed_Great_Barrier_Reef_C_2020_30m_OV.tif") %>%
					   crop(e) %>%
					   project("+proj=utm +zone=55 +south +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs")
site_points 		<- st_as_sf(ecodata_reduced, coords=c("Longitude", "latitude"), crs="+proj=longlat +ellips=WGS84") %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster)) %>%
					   filter(!str_detect(Site, "Urban Surrounds")) %>%
					   group_by(Site) %>%
					   summarize(geometry = st_centroid(st_union(geometry)))
ports       		<- st_read("data/ports.gpkg") %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster)) %>%
					   st_crop(site_points) %>%
					   filter(FACILITY == "Boat Ramp") %>%
					   filter(!NAME %in% c("Peter Faust Dam via Proserpine",
					   					   "Murray Creek, Landing Road",
										   "Mount Jukes, Howell's Road (Constant Creek)",
										   "Pleystowe",
										   "Kinchant Dam, Kinchant Dam Road",
										   "Teemburra Dam, Lucas Paddock Road",
										   "Eungella Dam, Eungella Dam Road",
										   "Andergrove, Apsley Way",
										   "Mackay, River Street",
										   "Dunnrock, Dunrock Esplanade",
										   "Proserpine River, Conway Road")) %>%
					   dplyr::select(NAME) %>%
					   rename(Site = "NAME") %>%
					   rename(geometry = "Shape")
border_poly 		<- st_read("data/Australia_Polygon.shp") %>%
                       filter(name == "Queensland") %>%
					   st_crop(e) %>%
					   st_transform(crs = st_crs(pop_raster))
```
# 3. Identify travel time between beaches and ports
## 3.1 Move beach and ports data to nearest ocean cell, then identify the nearest port to each beach
```{R}
# adjust bathy data to ocean
ocean_presence <- bathy
ocean_presence[ocean_presence >= 3] <- NA
ocean_presence[ocean_presence < 3] <- 1
ocean_presence <- mask(ocean_presence, border_poly, inverse = TRUE, touches = TRUE)
# Move beach and port points to nearest ocean cell
beach_points_moved <- move_points_to_ocean(site_points, ocean_presence, sitedata = "Site")
port_points_moved <- move_points_to_ocean(ports, ocean_presence, sitedata = "Site")
beaches_linked <- find_nearest_port(beach_points_moved, port_points_moved)
```
## 3.2 Calculate the travel time between beaches and ports
```{R}
ocean <- mask(bathy, border_poly, inverse = TRUE, touches = TRUE) %>%
         crop(st_buffer(beaches_linked, 5000))
ocean_trans <- get_ocean_transition(ocean, 10)
beaches_linked$ocean_trav <- 0
for(i in 1:nrow(beaches_linked)){
  beaches_linked[i, ]$ocean_trav <- get_ocean_travel(origin = beaches_linked[i, ],
				 destination = port_points_moved,
				 transition = ocean_trans,
				 output = "distance")
}
#zero out beaches next to roads. Shute harbor, shute harbour slipway, airlie beach,Coral Seas Boardwalk Airlie Beach, conway beach,
#canonvale beach
beaches_noocean <- c("Airlie Beach", "Cannonvale Beach", "Coral Seas Boardwalk, Airlie Beach", "Shute Harbour", "Shute Harbour Slipway", "Conway Beach")
beaches_linked$ocean_trav[beaches_linked$Site %in% beaches_noocean] <- 0
beaches_linked$nearest_port <- ifelse(beaches_linked$Site %in% beaches_noocean, beaches_linked$Site, beaches_linked$nearest_port)
st_write(beaches_linked, "data/beaches_linked.gpkg")

beaches_noport <- filter(beaches_linked, Site %in% beaches_noocean) %>% dplyr::select(Site, geometry)
st_write(rbind(beaches_noport, port_points_moved), "data/port_points_moved.gpkg")
#This generated line vectors for ocean travel of each location (for visualisation)
# for(i in 1:nrow(beaches_linked)){
# 	st_write(get_ocean_travel(origin = beaches_linked[i, ],
# 				 destination = port_points_moved,
# 				 transition = ocean_trans,
# 				 output = "object"), paste0("data/ocean_travel_", beaches_linked[i, ]$Site, ".gpkg"))
# }
```
# 4. Sensitivity analysis and external validation of gravity model

## 4.1 Sensitivity analysis of decay value
```{R}
data <- read.csv("outputs/decay_sensitivity.csv")
#Plot gravity against decay in box plots with error bars
ggplot(data, aes(x = Decay, y = gravity)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Gravity sensitivity to decay factor",
	   x = "Decay factor",
	   y = "Gravity") +
  theme_minimal()

# run a generalised linear model with gaussian distribution and site_name as a random effect
library(lme4)
library(effects)
library(car)
library(glmmTMB)
model <- lmer(gravity ~ Decay + (1|site_name), data = data)
#type 2 analysis of varience on model
car::Anova(model, type = "III")
summary(model)
plot(allEffects(model))

model <- glmmTMB(gravity ~ Decay + (1|site_name), data = data, family=Gamma(link="log"))
summary(model)
plot(allEffects(model))
datatoplot <- as.data.frame(allEffects(model))[[1]]
# plot the effects, they are points with upper and lower values
ggplot(data=datatoplot, aes(x=Decay, y=fit)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_path() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=lower, ymax=upper), width=.2) +
  xlab("Decay factor") + ylab("Gravity") +
  theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
    	axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 20))

ggplot(datatoplot, aes(x = Decay, y = fit)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
  labs(title = "Gravity sensitivity to decay factor",
	   x = "Decay factor",
	   y = "Gravity") +
  theme_minimal()


if (!requireNamespace("DHARMa", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("DHARMa")
library(DHARMa)

# Create simulated residuals
sim_res <- simulateResiduals(fittedModel = model, n = 250)

# Plot the residuals
plot(sim_res)

testDispersion(sim_res)
model$sdr
```
## 4.2 Validate the gravity model against tourism visitation data
```{R}
sites <- st_read("outputs/beaches_species_notscaled.gpkg")
data <- filter(data, site_name %in% sites$Site)
data_wide <- dcast(data, site_name ~ Decay, value.var = "gravity")
beaches <- sites %>% left_join(data_wide, by = c("Site" = "site_name"))
beaches <- st_buffer(beaches, 200)

visit_r <- rast("data/tourism_rast.tif")
rcl <- matrix(c(2147483647, NA), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
visit_r <- classify(visit_r, rcl)
for(i in 1:nrow(beaches)){
  beach <- beaches[i,]
  beaches$reef_vis[i] <- mean(terra::extract(visit_r, beach)$tourism_rast, na.rm = TRUE)
}
beach_cor <- filter(beaches, !is.na(reef_vis))
#Small
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Small, method = "pearson") #59
#mid
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Mid, method = "pearson") #0.5
#large
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Large, method = "pearson") #0.31
#Gravity
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$gravity, method = "pearson") #0.476

visit_r <- rast("data/tourism_value.tif") %>% crop(beaches) #visitation value
rcl <- matrix(c(65535, NA), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
visit_r <- classify(visit_r, rcl)
for(i in 1:nrow(beaches)){
  beach <- beaches[i,]
  beaches$reef_vis[i] <- mean(terra::extract(visit_r, beach)$tourism_value, na.rm = TRUE)
}
beach_cor <- filter(beaches, !is.na(reef_vis))
#small
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Small, method = "pearson") #.64
#mid
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Mid, method = "pearson")
#large
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$Large, method = "pearson")
#gravity
cor.test(beach_cor$reef_vis, beach_cor$gravity, method = "pearson") #0.53
```
# 5. Calculate gravity values
## 5.1 Calculate the gravity model through a single site to test the function
```{R}
beaches_linked <- st_read("data/beaches_linked.gpkg")
port_points_moved <- st_read("data/port_points_moved.gpkg")
ports_reduced <- port_points_moved %>%
				 filter(Site %in% beaches_linked$nearest_port) %>% vect()
#Look at a single land distance raster
# mapview(raster(get_land_distance(population = pop_raster,
#                   origin = ports_reduced[5, ],

# 				  decay_factor = 0.0001,
# 				  land_mask = border_poly))) + mapview(ports_reduced[5, ], color = "green") + mapview(queensland_roads)
r <- get_land_distance(population = pop_raster,
				   origin = ports_reduced[6, ],
				   structures = queensland_roads,
				   decay_factor = 0.00005,
				   land_mask = border_poly)
rlow <- get_land_distance(population = pop_raster,
				   origin = ports_reduced[6, ],
				   structures = queensland_roads,
				   decay_factor = 0.00001,
				   land_mask = border_poly)
rhigh <- get_land_distance(population = pop_raster,
				   origin = ports_reduced[6, ],
				   structures = queensland_roads,
				   decay_factor = 0.001,
				   land_mask = border_poly)

view(beaches_linked)
  	   calculate_gravity(study_site = beaches_linked[64,],
                                     population = pop_raster,
					                 land_distances = r,
					                 constant = 1)
```
## 5.2 Calculate the gravity model through all sites
```{R}
rasters <- list()
for (i in 1:nrow(ports_reduced)) {
  # Generate a raster using 'get_land_distance'
  r <- get_land_distance(population = pop_raster,
                         origin = ports_reduced[i, ],
                         structures = queensland_roads,
                         decay_factor = 0.0001,
                         land_mask = border_poly)
  # Add the raster to the list
  rasters[[i]] <- r
}
names(rasters) <- ports_reduced$Site
stack <- terra::rast(rasters)
writeRaster(stack, "data/land_distance_stack.tif", overwrite = TRUE)

beaches_linked <- st_read("data/beaches_linked.gpkg")
df <- data.frame(site_name = beaches_linked$Site, 
				 gravity = 0)
#land_distances <- rast("data/land_distance_stack.tif")
#put it together
for(i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  df$gravity[i] <- calculate_gravity(study_site = beaches_linked[i,],
                                     population = pop_raster,
					                 land_distances = land_distances,
					                 constant = 1)
}
write.csv(df, "outputs/gravity_final.csv")
```
